editorial_changes.text: A correction becomes useful only when it identifies what the original investigation got wrong and supplies the verified alternative. That is a different input from simply collecting another similar incident. The feedback path records that distinction so later work can treat a prior conclusion as corrected context.

editorial_changes.operation: remove explanation duplicated by the maintained mechanism detail
editorial_changes.text: Some guidance belongs in every new session, such as the format of an incident finding or the conventions used to name services. Standing instructions provide that context at startup. They are appropriate for persistent behavioral guidance rather than a procedure relevant only to one symptom.

editorial_changes.text: Global and agent-specific `AGENTS.md` text is supplied at startup; it is not selected by relevance. Changes apply to sessions started after saving. A running session retains its startup content. [DS09]

editorial_changes.operation: remove explanation duplicated by the maintained mechanism detail
editorial_changes.text: **Procedure:** add a skill from **Knowledge → Skills**, write a description naming the relevant symptoms and services, choose agent scope, and supply the procedure. Test a matching request and a nonmatching request. Inspect available run evidence for selection and tool use; document an unavailable signal as unverified rather than asserting selection.

editorial_changes.text: A cost question becomes a set of data queries with a specific comparison basis. The returned amounts, recommendations, and change records then support different conclusions. Reproducing the amount is the first step; explaining its cause requires additional evidence.
